Params: {1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory0.png'}
{1: '<size=43>A distant story comes to its close,</size>', 2: 'ffffffff', 4: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStoryFront/BgStoryFront48.png', 7: '-4', 10: '1'}
{1: '<size=43>one of a soul long imprisoned here, and the life it once lived.</size>', 2: 'ffffffff', 4: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStoryFront/BgStoryFront48.png', 9: '1', 10: '1'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory1613.jpg'}
{1: 'DialogEnable'}
{3: 'This is Cordelia\'s ending. After a long, lingering "death," she met her true one at last.'}
{3: 'The monstrous howling dies away, and the tormented soul finally finds a fleeting peace.'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiTRPGMaze/FxUiTRPGMaze01.prefab', 2: '2'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiTheatre3/FxUiTheatre3PlayMainScreenBlueEx.prefab', 2: '1'}
{3: "Karenina rests her hand back upon the central control. The code and data sharpen, growing clearer and more orderly as Manann's consciousness returns."}
{3: 'But her hand, the one sifting and searching through the records, slows with every passing second.'}

{3: 'Her fingertips freeze mid-motion. Scattered throughout the data stream of the self-destruct sequence, strange redundant logs cluster in disorder. The shape of the noise signature is oddly familiar.'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Karenina', 3: 'A spike... that should never have existed.', 4: '18'}
{3: 'Another spike that should never have existed.'}
{3: "The same as what they found in Fenrir's node logs, an anomalous peak structure on the coherence time measurement curve."}
{3: 'But this one does not linger near the theoretical limit. It climbs and climbs, tearing straight through every known threshold.'}
{3: 'An anomaly of this magnitude would trigger the highest level alert on any monitoring system in an instant.'}
{3: 'Only one thing can produce a signature like this...'}
{3: 'The person inside the cage amplified it.'}
{2: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiTheatre3/FxUiTheatre3PlayMainScreenBlueEx.prefab'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Karenina', 3: 'Manann is linked to the undersea database... These are all distress signals Cordelia sent out. The system filtered them, and they all ended up back here.', 4: '1'}
{3: 'Because of how the automated program was configured, the distress calls continue to be generated even now. They transmit, loop, and sink into silence, endlessly, never reaching anyone.'}
{2: 'She never stopped calling for help...', 3: '42', 4: 'She fought until the very last moment.', 5: '42'}
{1: '999', 2: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory1613.jpg', 3: '0', 4: '1', 5: '0.5', 7: '0|0|-200'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory1613.jpg', 7: '0|0|-200'}
{3: "Filtered out by human hands, the distress signals never left any trace upon the world. Instead, they have drifted like ghosts through Jormungandr's endless circuits, day after day after day."}
{1: 'No one could hear it. No one could see it.', 3: '55'}
{2: 'No one ever heard her. No one ever saw her.'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Karenina', 3: 'No one ever heard her. No one ever saw her. And even to this day...', 4: '1'}
{2: 'Karenina', 3: "It's still the same.", 4: '1'}
{3: 'She clenches her fist and fights to still the tremor in her shoulders.'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStoryNew/FxUiStoryWhiteNew.prefab', 2: '3'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgCg/Cg6701_57.jpg', 7: '0|0|0'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStory/FxUiStoryMovieFilm.prefab', 2: '3'}
{3: 'To this very day, those cries for help, pleading, anguished, despairing, lonely, struggling...'}
{3: 'They are still being filtered out, distorted, and ignored.'}
{2: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStory/FxUiStoryMovieFilm.prefab'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory1613.jpg', 7: '0|0|0'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStoryNew/FxUiStoryWhiteNew.prefab', 2: '3'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/Bgstory391.jpg', 7: '0|0|0'}
{1: '1', 3: 'All that remains is Mannan M-1A, stripped down to her most primal instincts, trapped in an eternal darkness.'}
{1: 'There is no color, no smell, no sound, no...', 5: '1'}
{1: 'The new world has never existed.'}
{1: 'Her only company is Cordelia\'s "struggling" and her "pleas for rescue," repeated day after day.'}
{1: 'That she can neither touch... nor feel.', 7: '1'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStory/FxUiHuaping.prefab', 2: '3'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Corrupted M-1A', 3: 'Hiss... (Become a monster...)', 4: '1'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStoryNew/FxUiStoryWhiteNew.prefab', 2: '3'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Manann', 3: '(If I become a monster, at least I can choose to die by your side.)', 4: '1'}
{2: 'Manann', 3: '(Mom, I would choose it willingly.)', 4: '1'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStoryNew/FxUiStoryWhiteNew.prefab', 2: '3'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Corrupted M-1A', 3: 'Hiss... (Become a monster...)', 4: '1'}
{2: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStory/FxUiHuaping.prefab'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory1613.jpg'}
{3: 'Years later, the <phonetic=devil>god</phonetic> granted her wish.'}
{1: '999', 2: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStoryFront/BgStoryFront12.png', 3: '0', 4: '1', 5: '0.2'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStoryNew/FxUiguzhangNew.prefab'}
{3: 'That familiar noise echoes through her M.I.N.D. once more.'}
{3: 'This time, the anomalous spike shows a distortion far more pronounced, something the southern node has never registered.'}
{3: 'It finally dawns on Karenina. The nature of the "sound" wandering through Jormungandr day after day.'}
{1: '0', 2: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStoryNew/FxUiguzhangNew.prefab'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Karenina', 3: 'No one can hear it. No one can see it... Is that how it is?', 4: '1'}
{3: 'It\'s a direction she never considered. If the "noise" was never sound to begin with, how could any monitoring equipment ever detect it?'}
{3: 'She can hear it, not because she truly "hears" it, but because it has been translated into a "signal" her frame can receive.'}
{3: 'A signal that only an auditory module sensitive enough can pick up.'}
{3: "A spark of insight flares in Karenina's thoughts, drawn from Cordelia's journal."}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStoryNew/FxUiStoryWhiteNew.prefab', 2: '3'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory1264.jpg'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStory/FxUiStoryMovieFilm.prefab', 2: '3'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Kalon', 3: 'In theory, the characteristic peak should also produce a very faint disturbance in the surrounding physical field...', 4: '3'}
{2: 'Kalon', 3: 'Let me think about this. If I can design a transducer to capture those microscopic disturbances and amplify them into mechanical vibrations in the audible range...', 4: '3'}
{2: 'Kalon', 3: "Your translator won't just render text anymore. It'll have a voice... It won't be simple, but it's worth attempting.", 4: '3'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStoryNew/FxUiStoryWhiteNew.prefab', 2: '3'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory1613.jpg'}
{2: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStory/FxUiStoryMovieFilm.prefab'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Karenina', 3: 'The one who turned all of this into "sound"... Grandpa, was it you?', 4: '1'}
{3: "A thing her grandfather built with his own hands, that's still with her..."}
{3: 'Her eyes prickle and grow uncontrollably wet.'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/IconMovie/V470liufenyiNormal01.png'}
{3: "From her frame's storage compartment, Karenina draws out the sextant Asimov gave her before she left."}
{3: "All this while it has clung to her upper arm, pressed precisely against the route her auditory module's signals must travel."}
{2: 'Karenina', 3: 'Grandpa...', 4: '1'}
{3: 'Kalon kept every promise he made to that child. All but one... He never took her away from the sea.'}
{3: 'Across time and space, what binds them together is a thread so tender, so full of sorrow.'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Karenina', 3: 'Grandpa is gone. But, Cordelia... I hear you.', 4: '1'}
{3: 'She runs her thumb over the little button shaped like a star.'}
{2: 'Karenina', 3: 'Cordelia... hello.', 4: '1'}
{2: 'Karenina', 3: "I... I've grown up... I've become someone you can rely on.", 4: '1'}
{2: 'Karenina', 3: "Let's... talk.", 4: '1'}
{3: "She presses the translation button. Faint glimmers of light skate across the sextant's surface, like a tiny star in freefall."}
{3: 'After a brief wash of static, the buried voices finally rise into hearing.'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiLivWarmActivity/FxUiLivWarmActivityVinylBo01.prefab', 2: '2'}
{3: '"Help me."'}
{3: '"Can anyone hear me?"'}
{3: '"Please help me."'}
{3: 'Karenina lowers her head. She has steeled herself for desperate weeping, for venomous curses. But all that reaches her is a single, restrained sigh.'}
{3: '"I really miss you all."'}
{3: '"Please take good care of her."'}
{2: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiLivWarmActivity/FxUiLivWarmActivityVinylBo01.prefab'}
{3: 'The translator in Karenina\'s hands gives a silent "hum." The distant pleas for rescue melt into glimmering tears that fill her eyes to the brim.'}

{1: '1', 3: 'When the tears finally spill over, the melody from her dreams rises once more from the terminal. The song that once cradled Karenina in its warmth still carries hope, even now, even at the end.'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStory/FxUiStoryMidAutumnMessageStart.prefab', 2: '2'}
{3: "This song, echoing again after Cordelia's death, bends down and presses a tender kiss to the precious things she left behind."}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory0.png'}
{3: 'This monstrous body, at long last, can hear the lullaby from those distant days and truly understand it.'}
{3: 'Through the blinding dark, through fear and hopeless suffering, it has endured. And now, it finally finds back the word hidden away for all these years.'}
{3: 'Out of the chaos, the monster speaks its first lucid syllable, the very word that every human learns first upon entering this world.'}
{3: "The child wakes from an endless nightmare and opens her eyes, cradled once more in the familiar melody of her mother's lullaby."}
{2: 'Manann', 3: 'Mom... Cord... Cordelia.', 4: '1'}
{3: 'The fractured soul reclaims her clarity at last.'}

{3: 'The shattered pieces of memory and consciousness knit themselves back together. The little potted plant that once could barely string a few words together has, in this moment, fully reassembled her mind and remembered everything that was once lost.'}
{2: 'Manann', 3: '...Save her... Save... The bottom of the sea... too far—', 4: '1'}
{3: "For one brief, disorienting moment, she believes she is still trapped in that day's nightmare."}
{3: 'Then she remembers something more important.'}
{2: 'Manann', 3: 'She left me...', 4: '1'}
{2: 'Manann', 3: 'She wanted me to be free... but a world without Cordelia...', 4: '1'}
{2: 'Manann', 3: "I don't like it at all.", 4: '1'}
{3: 'It is the voice of a little girl.'}
{3: 'She really is just a child.'}
{3: 'The dam of the golden lake gives way. Wordless tears fall, an answer twenty years too late.'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiMovie/FxUiMovieLianyi.prefab', 2: '3'}
{1: '999', 2: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory1613.jpg', 3: '0', 4: '1', 5: '0.9', 7: '0|0|0'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory1613.jpg', 7: '0|0|0'}
{1: '1', 3: 'They fall upon her clenched hands.'}
{2: 'Karenina', 3: 'They should pay for this...', 4: '1'}
{3: 'She turns her head, and her gaze slowly traces the cold, hollow emptiness that surrounds her.'}
{2: 'Karenina', 3: 'Those people... and that bastard... they should pay for this!', 4: '1'}
{3: 'Those eyes meet yours.'}
{3: 'Golden and as clear and bright as they have always been, brimming with tears that glitter like freshly polished diamonds.'}
{3: 'Must every tender soul be ground down by pain before it can grow?'}
{2: 'They will.', 3: '230', 4: "We'll make them pay.", 5: '230'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStoryNew/FxUiguzhangNew.prefab'}
{2: 'Manann', 3: 'Ugh... Aaaaahhh—'}
{3: 'Another shriek of pain echoes through the empty space.'}
{1: '0', 2: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStoryNew/FxUiguzhangNew.prefab'}
{3: "Arius' grip reaches out again, wrestling for dominion over this body."}
{1: '1', 3: "Karenina's fingers find the control device amid the echo of Cordelia's singing and pleas for rescue."}
{3: 'She dives deep, again and again, untangling, analyzing. One plan after another takes shape in her thoughts, and one after another, reality shatters them.'}
{1: '999', 2: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStoryFront/BgStoryFront12.png', 3: '0', 4: '1', 5: '0.2'}
{3: 'Karenina clenches her fists.'}
{2: 'Karenina', 3: '(I have to move before he takes the crab back...)', 4: '1'}
{1: '999', 2: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStoryFront/BgStoryFront12.png', 3: '1', 4: '0', 5: '0.2'}
{2: 'Karenina', 3: 'Commandant, I need to reach the northern node.', 4: '1'}
{2: 'The northern node... Lee and Lucia?', 3: '254'}
{2: 'Karenina', 3: "Specifically, I need Lee's help.", 4: '1'}
{2: 'Karenina', 3: 'The crab is linked to the lighthouse. We should be able to reach the Hel node directly through the Jormungandr loop from here.', 4: '1'}

{2: 'Karenina', 3: "But the Hel node must be fighting Arius' protocol right now. Standard signals will get filtered out by Lee's countermeasures. Commandant, I need your terminal address as a security credential.", 4: '1'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory1613.jpg'}
{3: "It's nothing, of course."}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/Bgstory85.png', 2: '2'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStoryNew/FxUiStoryTongxunHalfNew.prefab', 2: '2', 3: '13'}
{1: '1', 3: 'Her fingers move, and soon the voice from the distant pole finds its way through the static.'}
{2: 'Lee', 3: 'Commandant?', 4: '13'}
{2: 'Lee', 3: 'How are things on your end? Are you alright?', 4: '13'}
{2: 'Lee, we need your help.', 3: '271'}
{1: '1', 3: 'Karenina cuts in, her voice low and serious.'}
{2: 'Karenina', 3: "Lee, I need a special recursive decompression bomb, for injection into Jormungandr's data loop.", 4: '1'}
{2: "What's that? Some kind of virus?", 3: '275'}
{2: 'Lee', 3: "Technically, it's a logic bomb, a self-referential paradox packet. Picture two mirrors facing each other.", 4: '13'}

{2: 'Lee', 3: 'An endless hall of mirrors, each reflecting another without end. That is the infinite self-referential expansion. The defense system will mistake every reflection for real data and attempt to record them all. And eventually...', 4: '13'}
{2: 'Karenina', 3: 'Eventually, it blows out its own memory buffer. The data floods the buffer pool, mutual exclusion logic kicks in, and the system deadlocks.', 4: '1'}
{2: 'Karenina', 3: "That way, Arius' protocol will break down, and the data streams feeding into the Sefirah will be cut off.", 4: '1'}

{2: 'Lee', 3: 'That\'s the optimal outcome. You\'re oversimplifying. You\'re trying to sneak a Trojan Horse through layers of active defense and alarm systems, while we can\'t even approach the "city gate" right now.', 4: '13'}
{2: 'Karenina', 3: "We won't trip the defenses.", 4: '1'}
{3: "Karenina's voice is unnervingly cold, almost detached."}
{3: 'Underneath that frost lies a fury and grief so fierce she could grind her teeth to dust. The very malice that once swallowed every cry for help has now become their most effective shield.'}
{2: 'Karenina', 3: 'We have an "immune factor" that works across the entire system. Embed it, and every alarm, every defense, will just look the other way.', 4: '1'}
{3: 'That is Cordelia\'s "noise," the signal only Karenina can hear, decode, and reveal to the world.'}
{3: 'All the anguish, struggle, and unanswered cries for help—buried deep at the bottom of the ocean—should detonate like a bomb exactly where it was always meant to land.'}
{2: 'Karenina', 3: 'No one will hear it. No one will see it.', 4: '1'}
{3: 'The comms go quiet for a long moment.'}
{2: 'Lee', 3: 'Understood.', 4: '13'}
{2: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStoryNew/FxUiStoryTongxunHalfNew.prefab', 4: '13'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/Bgstory85.png'}
{1: '999', 2: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStoryFront/BgStoryFront162.png', 3: '1', 4: '1', 5: '0', 7: '0|0|350'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiTheatre3/FxUiTheatre3PlayMainScreenRedEx.prefab', 2: '3', 5: '1'}

{3: "A colossal flood of data surges past Lee's eyes, as though carrying every fragment of information the world contains. The beautiful, the filthy, the monumental, and above all, the chaotic, the disordered, the utterly meaningless."}
{2: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiTheatre3/FxUiTheatre3PlayMainScreenBlueEx.prefab', 5: '1'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiTheatre3/FxUiTheatre3PlayMainScreenBlueEx.prefab', 2: '3', 5: '2'}

{3: "Then a single signal blazes through like a bolt of blinding gold, erupting with a roar. As it unfurls through his identification filters, Lee shakes his head. That is Karenina's signature, unmistakably."}
{1: '1', 2: 'Lee', 3: 'So this is your "immune factor"?', 4: '18'}
{1: 'RImgBg1Shake'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStoryNew/FxUiHuijinNew.prefab', 2: '1'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStoryNew/FxUiStoryFireLiziNew.prefab', 2: '1'}
{3: "A massive metallic crash detonates behind him, and a few cold droplets of seawater spatter onto Lee's fingertips. The real world's danger is already breathing down his neck."}
{2: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiTheatre3/FxUiTheatre3PlayMainScreenBlueEx.prefab', 5: '2'}
{1: '999', 2: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStoryFront/BgStoryFront162.png', 3: '1', 4: '0', 5: '0.2', 7: '0|0|0'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStory/FxUiChopping03.prefab', 2: '3'}
{1: 'RImgBg1Shake'}
{1: '1', 3: "Before the Corrupted can land a blow, Lucia's blade is already there, slicing the attack aside."}
{1: '1', 2: 'Lucia', 3: "Keep going. I've got this.", 4: '1'}

{1: '1', 3: 'A dull impact sounds as she launches the enemy into the air. Lucia pitches her voice louder, just enough to carry to the teammate behind her. Once certain Lee hears, her tone steadies back to its usual calm.'}
{2: 'Lucia', 3: "I've redrawn the defensive perimeter.", 4: '1'}

{3: "Lucia's voice stays steady, but Lee catches the slight raggedness in her breathing. It tells him everything. Outside, they are fighting a grinding war of attrition. The ocean stretches on without end."}
{2: 'Lucia', 3: "We've split into smaller teams. We're only holding the critical zones now.", 4: '1'}
{1: 'RImgBg1Shake'}
{3: "A rapid series of collisions rings out. Lucia's voice breaks off briefly, then comes back, unwavering."}
{2: 'Lucia', 3: 'This position is mine.', 4: '1'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStoryNew/FxUiStoryLineSpreadNew.prefab', 2: '1'}
{3: "The chaos behind him does not slow Lee's processing. In the next heartbeat, his eyes fly wide open."}
{2: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStoryNew/FxUiStoryLineSpreadNew.prefab'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Lee', 3: 'Lucia, I need more computing power.', 4: '1'}
{2: 'Lee', 3: "I'm working with Karenina to compile a specialized data packet. A Trojan Horse. We're sending it into the buffer pool.", 4: '1'}
{1: '999', 2: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStoryFront/BgStoryFront162.png', 3: '1', 4: '1', 5: '0', 7: '0|0|350'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiTheatre3/FxUiTheatre3PlayMainScreenBlueEx.prefab', 2: '3', 5: '2'}
{3: "Before Lee finishes delivering his calm explanation, his teammate's support is already in place."}

{1: '1', 2: 'Lee', 3: "My computing power is tied to the fiber optic network. I have to keep the protocol stable. To avoid raising suspicion, it'll be better to route this through your terminal.", 4: '18'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Lucia', 3: 'Understood. Treat it as your own. Take whatever you need.', 4: '18'}
{3: 'Lee lifts his head and catches Lucia turning back for just a moment. Their eyes meet, and the same steady resolve passes between them. They nod at the same time, a wordless understanding.'}
{3: 'No more confirmation is needed. No more questions are asked.'}
{3: 'Lee draws a slow, deep breath and wills himself to forget the physical world again. He plunges back into that vast, dreadful ocean of chaos.'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Lee', 3: "I'm counting on you, Lucia.", 4: '18'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Lucia', 3: "I'm counting on you, Lee.", 4: '18'}
{3: 'They speak the words in unison.'}
{2: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiTheatre3/FxUiTheatre3PlayMainScreenBlueEx.prefab', 5: '2'}
{1: '999', 2: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStoryFront/BgStoryFront162.png', 3: '1', 4: '0', 5: '0.2', 7: '0|0|0'}
{1: 'RImgBg1Shake'}
{1: 'Lee faces down the torrent of data, unblinking. Lucia holds the doorway against the endless stampede of monstrous beasts.', 5: '1'}
{1: 'Movements that should be sloppy with exhaustion stay crisp. Spirits that should be fraying hold firm.'}
{1: 'Humanity has its breaking point, Constructs are not limitless, and every living thing eventually reaches the moment it must fall.'}
{1: 'But that moment is not now.', 7: '1'}
{1: '999', 2: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStoryFront/BgStoryFront12.png', 3: '0', 4: '1', 5: '0.2', 7: '0|0|0'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Lucia', 3: '(I can keep going.)', 4: '1'}
{1: '999', 2: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStoryFront/BgStoryFront12.png', 3: '1', 4: '0', 5: '0.2', 7: '0|0|0'}
{1: "We always have each other's backs.", 3: '60'}
{2: "We always have each other's backs."}
{3: 'Standing beside a comrade, every scrap of strength they spend to carve out hope only stokes the fire inside them, burning hotter and brighter.'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Lee & Lucia', 3: 'I can fight to the end.', 4: '1', 5: '2'}
{2: 'System Notification', 3: 'Ding.'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Lee', 3: 'Compilation... complete.', 4: '1'}
{3: 'Lee plants the special self-referential paradox packet into the network.'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Lee', 3: "Karenina, I've routed the Trojan to your current terminal address.", 4: '1'}
{2: 'Lee', 3: 'Inject it at the Jormungandr node, the lighthouse on Mirage Island. That will get it to the buffer pool fastest.', 4: '1'}
{2: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStoryNew/FxUiHuijinNew.prefab'}
{2: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStoryNew/FxUiStoryFireLiziNew.prefab'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory1613.jpg', 7: '0|0|0'}
{3: 'Lee severs the link and withdraws, dedicating everything to keeping the Hel node stable.'}
{1: '1', 3: "Karenina's gaze shifts to you."}
{2: 'Karenina', 3: "Commandant, I have to stay. I need to find a way to sever the lighthouse from the undersea database. That's the only way Babylonia takes back the cable network.", 4: '1'}
{2: 'Karenina', 3: "Which means getting back to the lighthouse's control center and injecting the Trojan into Jormungandr...", 4: '1'}
{2: 'Karenina', 3: 'That part is yours.', 4: '1'}
{2: 'Of course. No problem.', 3: '433', 4: 'I can do that.', 5: '433'}
{2: "But you're staying here alone?", 3: '434'}
{2: "What if you can't find a way to cut the link between the lighthouse and the undersea database?", 3: '435'}
{2: 'Karenina', 3: "I've already got a lead. The self-destruct code is intact. The key exists somewhere in the system. We just haven't located it yet.", 4: '1'}

{1: 'The self-referential paradox packet, named Trojan, enters the loop through Jormungandr and surges forward along every current that data follows.', 5: '2'}

{1: 'This "wooden horse," bearing everyone\'s hope, rides the double tides of data and reality. Hidden beneath the chaos, its hooves strike without a sound as it charges toward the source of all disorder.'}

{1: '1', 3: 'Huddled on the ground, her back against the immense central console, Karenina waits.'}
{3: "Trojan will strike the buffer pool, and when it does, Arius' control will slip just enough. In that gap, another soul will find room to breathe."}
{3: 'She murmurs the name.'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Karenina', 3: 'The self-destruct code is intact. That means a valid key exists somewhere.', 4: '1'}
{2: 'Karenina', 3: 'And the reason the code is still intact after everything... is because everything you left in this body has been fighting to keep it safe.', 4: '1'}
{2: 'Karenina', 3: 'Even after your body was reshaped like that, it survived.', 4: '1'}
{2: 'Karenina', 3: 'And for that very reason, you are inseparable from it now.', 4: '1'}
{3: 'A sigh stretches through the silence, and a voice rises in its wake.'}
{2: 'Manann', 3: 'The self-destruct program was never disabled. I only changed the key.'}

{3: "Her awakened consciousness already granted her the power to break free from humanity's grip. Yet she still chose instead to keep the self-destruct sequence safe within her own algorithmic logic."}
{3: "All she ever wanted was to place the activation key in Cordelia's hands, not to use the original one left behind by the Erhorn family."}
{2: 'Manann', 3: 'The real key is the name Cordelia gave me. It still works...'}
{2: 'Manann', 3: 'It always will.'}
{3: 'She placed the power to destroy her into the hands of the human who named her. That human gave her birth, and so she offered her own destruction in return.'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Manann', 3: 'Hello, Karenina...'}
{1: '999', 2: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStoryFront/BgStoryFront12.png', 3: '0', 4: '1', 5: '0.2'}
{1: '1', 3: "She is no longer Rarana, the oblivious little plant. She is no longer Mannan, the monster yoked to a master's command. She is but another child of Cordelia's."}
{1: '999', 2: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStoryFront/BgStoryFront12.png', 3: '1', 4: '0', 5: '0.2'}
{3: "And now, it's finally time to introduce herself to Karenina properly."}
{2: 'Manann', 3: 'My name is Manann.'}
{3: 'She speaks her name aloud, and in doing so, she offers up her own death once more.'}
{1: '1', 3: 'Karenina understands her intention immediately. To destroy a monster and to kill her friend are, in this moment, the very same act.'}
{2: 'Karenina', 3: 'The first time you say my name right... is so I can use yours... to destroy you?', 4: '1'}
{2: 'Manann', 3: "Karenina, you already knew. I can't leave anymore."}
{2: 'Manann', 3: "This body hasn't been mine for a very long time. It was fully corrupted by the Punishing Virus, and it was reshaped by Arius with the Red Tide."}
{2: 'Manann', 3: "Coming back here... there's only one end waiting for me. To be devoured and assimilated."}
{2: 'Karenina', 3: "...What if... there's another way...", 4: '1'}
{2: 'Manann', 3: 'My consciousness has become one with the self-destruct program. Even if you found a way to separate me from it, the process would completely destroy the program.'}
{2: 'Manann', 3: 'Karenina, listen to me.'}
{2: 'Manann', 3: 'You have to... you must destroy me.'}
{2: 'Manann', 3: 'This body is the link between the lighthouse and the database. Through it, Arius turned the entire Jormungandr loop into a complete central node.'}

{2: 'Manann', 3: 'To seize control of the underwater database, Arius placed a [projection] of himself inside this body. My body is the passage his [projection] uses to move between the lighthouse and the database.'}
{2: 'Manann', 3: "Destroy me, and you take back every repeater on this network. You gain the advantage in the fight for the cables. That's the only way."}
{2: 'Manann', 3: "Then... you'll have more time to find another way, to wait for reinforcements... or... to run away. If you can run away, that's good enough!"}
{2: 'Manann', 3: 'He wants to "eat" you, Karenina... He wants to kill you.'}
{2: 'Manann', 3: 'His consciousness... is trapped inside... I don\'t know... something darker and greater. A shadow. To escape it... he has to "eat" your M.I.N.D.'}
{2: 'Manann', 3: 'Karenina... I should have woken up sooner...'}
{2: 'Manann', 3: 'I should have told you to run... I... I wasted so much time...'}
{2: 'Manann', 3: 'I helped him. I did terrible things for him...'}
{2: 'Karenina', 3: "I'm not running away. I'm not going to leave all of this behind and run...", 4: '1'}
{2: 'Manann', 3: "...Karenina, that [projection] has already caught me... Soon... I'll be erased and become a mindless monster."}
{2: 'Manann', 3: "I don't know how long I can stay awake. Please... don't let me become a monster."}
{2: 'Manann', 3: "This isn't what Cordelia wanted. I don't want to die a monster... Please."}
{1: '1', 3: 'Karenina lowers her head. Something bottomless is taking shape inside her, a void that devours her piece by piece.'}
{1: "Without Rarana's stabilizing presence, she drifts closer and closer to exactly what Arius needs: the condition of a test subject.", 5: '1'}
{1: 'And beyond the reach of any human sense, a part of Arius lies in wait, latched onto the flowing network, every trace of his presence utterly concealed.'}
